hare_burrow.name: Hare burrow
hare_burrow.examine: Fresh droppings and a well-worn run. Something lives here.

fox_den.name: Fox den
fox_den.examine: A sandy hole under the roots, ringed with feathers and small bones.

dormouse_nest.name: Dormouse nest
dormouse_nest.examine: A hollow at the foot of an old olive, stuffed with leaves. Something fat is asleep in there.
